title: The Energy Cost of a Phase Shift
description: LaTeX source, numerical checks (120) and a Lean 4 certificate (57 theorems) of the finite and algebraic parts of the paper The Energy Cost of a Phase Shift. The paper proves that a passive causal system without zeros in the upper half-plane cannot shift every frequency of a band [a,b] by the same phase theta > 0 without loss: its mean attenuation over the band is at least theta (K(kappa) - E(kappa))/kappa nepers, kappa = (b-a)/(b+a), and an explicit system attains this.
